svg.title: Which task an event of an issue gives the AI
svg.desc: An event of a bot, on a pull request, or a new issue that a maintainer opened gives the AI no task. Otherwise, a new issue, or the command /assistant again, gives it triage. An answer of the reporter to the assistant's questions gives it follow-up, at most twice and only while no maintainer joined the conversation since the questions. A comment of a maintainer on a reporter's issue that waits for nobody gives it maintainer-reply. A comment of the reporter within 30 days after a release closed the issue gives it release-reply. A maintainer's command /assistant ask gives it maintainer-question. Any other event, such as a comment of someone else, gives it no task. A ticked box of the issue form adds the label assistant-muted to the new issue. On an issue with that label, only a command of a maintainer, or the reporter's /assistant again after the box, starts a task. A task runs only while the AI is on and its secret is set; otherwise no analysis comes, and labels, reminders and closing go on.
